lag_regime.basis: EU AI Act: adopted by the Parliament 13 Mar 2024, obligations on general-purpose models applicable 2 Aug 2025 (between five and six quarters); the delay of H.regulate_up

lag_oversight.basis: UK AI Safety Institute: announced Nov 2023, first pre-deployment test results published in 2024 (not verified); the delay of H.fund_oversight

lag_scale.basis: a frontier campus phase from announced site to first operation within a year at the fastest observed (Abilene 2025, not verified); the delay of L.scale

lag_build.basis: new firm power for a campus takes a year at the fastest and several years through an interconnection queue (IEA, Energy and AI, Apr 2025); the delay of L.build_power is the fast end

lag_self_improve.basis: no record: an untested mechanism, swept against 0 (agi_testbed.md section 6 item 3); the delay of A.self_improve
